content: Signal X3DH/double ratchet in .NET: no mature NuGet library exists (search returned only Lucinda.Blazor, 464 downloads, browser WebCrypto). whatsmeow uses separate go.mau.fi/libsignal v0.2.2. .NET path: clean-room implement from Signal spec + behavioral cross-check, on NSec X25519/Ed25519 plus in-box AES-CBC/HMAC-SHA256/HKDF. Sources NuGet search API + whatsmeow go.mod. Confidence HIGH for absence, MEDIUM for effort estimate.
